name: autocomplete
title: Autocomplete
purpose: Enter text with filtered suggestions and keyboard navigation, or choose one or more suggestions while retaining a searchable query.
useFor: Finding an item by partial text
avoidFor: A short fixed list without filtering
Remote search without a loading strategy

composition.styling: Consumer class and style attributes merge onto the native input while shared helpers preserve the Balsa field language.
composition.multiple: Set multiple to bind a string array, keep the query editable, toggle suggestions without closing the list, and render removable selected-value actions.
composition.popup: The suggestion list uses a manually controlled browser top-layer popover when available so overflow containers do not clip it and a focus click cannot light-dismiss it.

accessibility: Uses editable combobox semantics with an associated listbox.
Arrow keys, Enter, Escape, and Tab follow expected combobox behavior; Backspace removes the final selected value only when a multiple-mode query is empty.
Multiple mode exposes aria-multiselectable and gives every selected value an accessible remove action.
The active suggestion is exposed through aria-activedescendant.
The top-layer suggestion list remains structurally associated with its input.
commonMistakes: Using suggestions as an inaccessible visual-only menu.
Omitting a stable id and visible label.
Using it for a tiny fixed list.
